controls.description: Recover a disclosed Caesar shift of seven from the toy fixture.
Reserved fixture with deterministic separator noise.
Reserved character-preserving shuffle on which the worker must not claim exact recovery.
Reserved over-parameterized mapping that can fit discovery text but must fail confirmation.
Interrupted and uninterrupted execution must produce identical output bytes.

note: Only the positive toy control is executable in this foundation branch; the others specify required benchmark classes.
